market_view: VIX 16 after a +13% week; 10y at a 52-week high of 5.26% after bonds' worst month in years, but August core PCE at 3.0% came in much lighter than expected. Oil is easing on recovering Middle East exports; gold is near multi-month lows.

oil_gas.catalyst: none; 'Oil prices settle down 2.5% on signs Middle East exports recovering' (Reuters) is a de-escalation headline
oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -5.5% over 5d, US-Iran hopes and recovering exports. No confirmed named supply loss, so no long under the storyline rule.

gold_miners.catalyst: none; lighter core PCE could cap yields but the 10y is still at a 52-week high and the dollar is firm
gold_miners.reasoning: Gold -4.5% over 5d at multi-month lows. Newmont record free cash flow headlines describe old results, not new ones. A jobs report falls inside the window, which adds variance, not a direction.

chips.catalyst: 'Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold' (CNBC): hard AI demand data that answers last week's Oracle force-majeure doubts; spillover to NVDA only partly priced (NVDA -0.7% on 9/29)
chips.reasoning: Renew NVDA (current hold ends about 10-01) on a fresh guidance-type catalyst for the AI chip chain. DeepSeek/Huawei headline is a risk. Confidence stays at the bar because the catalyst is indirect.

pharma.catalyst: mixed: 'Lilly's EloraTZP ... delivered greater weight loss' and orforglipron CV safety (Eli Lilly) vs 'US Cements Most-Favored-Nation Drug Price Model for Medicare' (Bloomberg Law) and a headline of LLY falling 2.33%
pharma.reasoning: Existing LLY hold (to about 10-06) continues. Not renewed: the trial news was mid-stage and the market seems to have read it coolly, and MFN pricing becoming permanent hurts pharma.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none new; the Sunsirs supply-pressure piece is generic. BHP Chile halt carried from 09-25 with no restart news
copper_uranium.reasoning: Existing FCX hold (to about 10-09) continues. Copper -3.2% and FCX -4.8% over 5d. No fresh supply headline to justify renewing. US-Korea nuclear framework is long-dated for CCJ.

would_change_my_mind: A confirmed named oil supply loss (XOM), a fresh copper mine outage or export ban (FCX renewal), or an AI capex cut or chip export hit (exit NVDA).

handoff.what_changed: WTI 89.38 (-5.5% over 5d) as Middle East exports recover; 10y 5.26% at a 52-week high, but core PCE at 3.0% was much lighter than expected; gold 4180 near multi-month lows. Micron beat and guided strongly (data center revenue up 11x); Lilly reported EloraTZP Phase 2 and orforglipron CV safety data while the US cemented MFN pricing for Medicare. XOM 09-14 closed -1.80%.

oil_gas.why: Exports recovering and US-Iran hopes; no confirmed named supply loss.

gold_miners.why: 10y at a 52-week high and firm dollar; lighter PCE is not yet a gold catalyst.

chips.why: Renewed on Micron beat and strong guidance (CNBC), a fresh AI demand signal; confidence 0.52.

pharma.why: Held to about 10-06; not renewed because of mixed trial reception and MFN pricing.

copper_uranium.why: Held to about 10-09 on BHP Chile mine halt; not renewed, no fresh supply headline.

open_storylines.name: Hormuz / Iran war, Saudi supply
open_storylines.note: Middle East exports recovering, US-Iran talks. Re-enter XOM only on a confirmed named supply loss; a deal closes it.

open_storylines.name: Yields, inflation and the Fed
open_storylines.note: 10y 5.26% at a 52-week high, bonds worst month in years; core PCE 3.0% much lighter than expected may cap yields. Jobs report within 20 days. Gold headwind.

open_storylines.name: AI demand, NVDA
open_storylines.note: Micron beat with data center revenue up 11x vs Oracle force majeure and DeepSeek/Huawei push. Exit NVDA on guidance cut or export hit; new hold ends about 10-14.

open_storylines.name: Tariffs and trade war
open_storylines.note: New global tariffs face trade court challenge (CNBC, NYT). Watch copper, pharma tariffs.

open_storylines.name: Lilly GLP-1 pipeline and pricing
open_storylines.note: EloraTZP Phase 2 win and orforglipron CV safety, but stock reportedly fell 2.3%; MFN model cemented for Medicare. Watch pricing policy and trial readouts.

open_storylines.name: Copper supply tightness
open_storylines.note: BHP Chile mine halt (09-25) with no restart news; copper -3.2% over 5d. Exit on restart, supply release or China demand slump.

open_storylines.name: Uranium supply and nuclear policy
open_storylines.note: US-Korea nuclear deployment framework; uranium ETF -12% over 20d. No near-term CCJ catalyst.

handoff.next_job: Next decision day: NVDA held to about 10-14 (check AI capex, export rules, Q3 previews); LLY ends about 10-06 (renew only on a fresh trial or guidance catalyst, watch MFN pricing); FCX ends about 10-09 (BHP restart, copper, China data); XOM flat unless a confirmed named supply loss; watch the jobs report and yields for gold.

lessons.rule: Hypothesis only: oil longs on a named supply-shock escalation headline have no net edge over 10 days once the episode is long-running.
Hypothesis only: LLY longs after a trial or guidance catalyst have a positive mean net return over 10 days.
Hypothesis only: copper longs on a fresh supply-squeeze headline win.
lessons.evidence: FCX 07-31 +5.91% (CNBC squeeze), 08-10 +10.09% (Reuters Congo ban). Continuations: 08-05 -0.68%, 08-13 +17.10%, 08-18 +9.02%. No new closed trades; 09-25 BHP halt entry still open.
